newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ill. Superconductor buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ill. Superconductor buy reiterated.

text.p: -Gruntal & Co analyst Mona Eraiba said Wednesday she reiterated her rating on Illinois Superconductor of outperform-speculative. She recommended buying the stock for speculative accounts only.

-Illinois Superconductor reported fourth quarter results in line with expectations, Eraiba said. The company reported a net loss of $0.68 a share versus a loss of $0.48. Eraiba pointed out that fourth quarter revenues of $125,000 were triple those reported in the third quarter.
-The company continued to invest in its product line and is working on a new transmitter filter, Eraiba said.
-Shares of Illinois Superconductor, which provides radio frequency products, traded off 23/64 at 16-3/8.
